_about: Task categories for subagents. Every generic Agent call names one as a [slug] at the start of its description and uses its model and effort. No category fits: add one here before the call. A deliberate different model/effort: put (override: reason) in the description.

triage.when: Read a ticket or card and classify it, pick a label, answer a yes/no about it
examples: Which column is this card in

lookup.when: Find files or symbols, read a page, fetch one known fact; no judgement beyond finding it
examples: Where is the rating prompt armed
Read this docs page and quote the limit

chore.when: Mechanical edits with a clear rule: strip comments or history, rename, reformat, bulk move, regenerate a file

test-qa.when: Run tests, walk a flow in a simulator or browser, collect evidence, report pass/fail
examples: Run tests and QA for PROJ-20

implement.when: Write or change code for a ticket, fix, refactor or feature whose design is already decided

research.when: Gather facts from code, docs or the web across several sources and summarise them
examples: Research facts for a blog post

data.when: Pull and crunch numbers: analytics, store data, logs, spreadsheets

media-build.when: Produce media from an agreed brief: reel or cartoon episode, art generation, prototype scene
examples: Build episode 13 of a reel series

persona.when: Play a user or character in a simulated run or playtest
examples: User review as a non-technical reader

review.when: Find bugs or risks: code review, requirements review, security review, test or repo audit, adversarial check
examples: Bug hunt in the reporting module

copy.when: Text people will read: product copy, translations and localisation, articles, letters, editing, study notes
examples: Tone pass on Russian UI copy

critique.when: Judge design or creative work: UX, visual, reel, game feel, mascot or brand council seat

design.when: Decide architecture, product direction or a plan; debug something not yet understood
examples: Debug a crash nobody understands yet
